verdict.rationale: Mercury's invoicing documents recurring invoices set up "in a few clicks and at your chosen frequency," plus creating, sending and tracking invoices, and invoicing data feeds into Books automatically. Nothing in the pack covers automatic payment reminders or dunning for overdue customers, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: automatic overdue payment reminders/dunning, in-depth docs on recurring invoice configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
